rule_basis: Test the same earlier-attacker exclusion using an explicit type61 ball-touch event by a non-scorer. This is a separate schema route: a positively recorded actual attacking touch may restrict earlier candidates, but does not itself award an assist. Require the same full control gates; any protected-award or FPL contradiction rejects the route.
guards: Exclude penalties, direct free kicks and own goals. Use the latest type61 non-scorer scoring-team ball-touch event strictly before the goal, within60seconds and in the same period. Require one unambiguous boundary event and unique player identity. Retain every scoring-team actor at or after the boundary timestamp, plus the touch actor, excluding only the scorer. Missing event identities/types, deletion or coverage markers, another goal or a foul make the rule abstain. No inferred defensive contact counts, no awarded assists and no missing-marker zeros.
validation: Freeze before outcomes. Same full2025 scoring-team plan; at least20 applicable unresolved controls and20 one-goal controls; zero infeasible team vectors, one-goal errors, protected-award conflicts or empty intersections with existing positive source candidate sets. No conflict-based selective dropping and no lower thresholds. Reused outcomes and shared Opta source mean temporal regression, not independent validation.
application: If qualified, apply to previously unresolved pre2025 goals with complete goal/scorer/team coverage. Preserve cumulative earlier candidate exclusions and every previously complete player total. Retain external quality flags, rawFPL, approved corrections and locked scoring.
